title: Sakthi Accounts
summary: Daily profit, expenses, credit and staff ledgers for a multi-branch mobile shop.
problem: Each branch ran several counters (sales, recharge wallets, services) with daily cash, expenses, stock, staff advances and customer credit tracked in notebooks and an Excel sheet. Month-end profit was a guess.
solution: A profit management system where the owner defines counters and operations, and staff enter the day's figures in forms built from that setup. Daily summaries add up the totals with formulas, and ledgers and reports show profit per branch.

features.title: Configurable counters and operations
features.description: The owner adds a counter or a new entry type without a developer.

features.title: Smart daily summaries
features.description: Fields can be manual, totalled from other entries, or calculated by formula.

features.title: Staff and customer ledgers
features.description: Advances, salary, credit given and collected, per person.

features.title: Branch and role access
features.description: Admin, supervisor, manager and employee each see their own scope.

features.title: Financial reports
features.description: Financial overview and capital position across branches.

features.title: Recharge data built in
features.description: Daily recharge sales arrive automatically from Sakthi EC.

aiNote: AI helped turn the owner's Excel sheet into a configuration model, so new counters need setup instead of code.
results: Month-end is no longer a guessing game
One system across branches and counters
